description: Bring up the whole-machine single-instance TP8 topology with SGLang v0.5.17-cu130 serving the preview DSpark weights, confirm DSpark is active, then run the standard bench sweep. Depends on FEAT-001 (weights downloaded). Uses --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 (NOT megamoe) per repo+Runbook warning that megamoe+EP8+DSPARK+cuda-graph crashes on B300.
steps: Launch SGLang TP8 with the exact flags from the user Runbook (option A), base64-encoding the launch as a script to avoid send-command quoting issues. Run detached: `docker run -d --name sglang-tp8 --runtime nvidia --network host --ipc host --shm-size 16g -v /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme -v sgljit:/root/.cache -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark --tp 8 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --mem-fraction-static 0.90 --trust-remote-code --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 --enable-metrics --chunked-prefill-size 4096 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30080`.

Poll `docker logs sglang-tp8` (tail) every few minutes. Cold start can take 10-25 min (weight load + JIT/DeepGEMM compile + FlashInfer autotune + cuda-graph capture). Watch for the DSpark confirmation line 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head' and for 'Application startup complete' / server ready.

Confirm health: SSM send-command `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:30080/health` returns 200. If startup errors (mxfp4 kernel issue, DSpark not attaching, OOM at mem-fraction 0.90), capture the full docker logs, diagnose, and apply a reasonable fix (e.g. drop mem-fraction-static to 0.85, adjust cuda-graph-max-bs). Record any deviation from the Runbook flags in findings.
Smoke one /v1/chat/completions request through 127.0.0.1:30080 to confirm end-to-end generation before the sweep.

Validate range-ratio semantics with c=1 BEFORE the full sweep: run one bench_serving at c=1 and confirm it takes a fixed 40k input (SGLang range-ratio semantics differ from vLLM's). If SGLang rejects --random-range-ratio 1.0, adjust to the value that yields fixed 40k for this SGLang version and record the change in findings.

Run the full sweep inside the container, writing to /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/: for C in 1 2 4 8 16 with NP map {1:8, 2:8, 4:12, 8:24, 16:48}, `python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang-oai --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30080 --dataset-name random --random-input-len 40000 --random-output-len 1500 --random-range-ratio <validated> --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts $NP --flush-cache --output-file /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/c${C}.jsonl 2>&1 | tee /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/c${C}.log`. Background with nohup + poll since the full sweep is long.

For each level record from the bench output: TTFT median/p90/p99, TPOT median/p90/p99, ITL, output token throughput, and the Speculative Decoding section (DSpark accept rate + accept length). Confirm accept len > 1.0 (spec-decode accepting); if ~1.00, investigate whether DSpark was stripped.
acceptance_criteria: `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:30080/health` returns HTTP 200 with sglang-tp8 running on all 8 GPUs (nvidia-smi shows memory used across cards 0-7).
Startup log contains 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head' (DSpark head attached).
A smoke chat completion through 127.0.0.1:30080 returns a valid response.
bench_serving completes all 5 concurrency levels (c=1,2,4,8,16) with 0 failed requests and completed == num_prompts, producing /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/c{1,2,4,8,16}.jsonl + .log.
DSpark accept length is captured per level and is > 1.0 at least at low concurrency (or a documented investigation explains why not).
verification: SSM send-command `docker logs sglang-tp8 2>&1 | grep -i 'DSpark head'` returns the confirmation line.

SSM send-command `ls -la /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ && grep -h 'Successful requests\|Mean TPOT\|accept' /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/c*.log` shows all 5 files with completed requests and TPOT/accept stats.
findings:
COMPLETED 2026-09-14. All acceptance criteria met. Server left RUNNING for FEAT-003 (do NOT re-download weights; FEAT-003 will `docker rm -f sglang-tp8` before launching PD).

(0) BASELINE: SSM Online. Defensive teardown ran clean (no platform container had re-deployed this time); all 8 GPUs 0 MiB before launch; weights present at /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark (156G, config.json). NVMe 26T free.

(1) LAUNCH: base64-encoded launch script -> /opt/dlami/nvme/launch_tp8.sh, ran detached. EXACT Runbook option-A flags used verbatim, NO deviation from server flags: image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130, --tp 8 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --mem-fraction-static 0.90 --trust-remote-code --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 --enable-metrics --chunked-prefill-size 4096 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30080. docker run: --runtime nvidia --network host --ipc host --shm-size 16g -v /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme -v sgljit:/root/.cache -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0..7.

(2) STARTUP: clean, NO errors, NO OOM at mem-fraction 0.90 (megamoe was correctly AVOIDED; flashinfer_mxfp4 loaded as Mxfp4FlashinferTrtllmMoEMethod, 'FlashInfer TRTLLM MoE deferred finalize is disabled'). Cold start ~13 min wall (02:08 launch -> 02:22 ready). Phases observed: weight load (48/48 shards, load_weight=390s), FlashInfer trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe autotune (~85s), DeepGEMM JIT precompile, cuda-graph capture (target_verify=33.3s, draft_decode=51.3s -> spec-decode graphs captured). Log 'The server is fired up and ready to roll!'. All 8 GPUs ~252.5 GB used (0.90 of 275GB). DSPARK CONFIRMED on all 8 TP ranks: 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head; loading draft arch DeepseekV4ForCausalLMDSpark.' Also 'Auto-detected DSV4 routed-expert layout: is_fp4_experts=True'. /health=200.

(3) SMOKE: /v1/chat/completions ('capital of France?') -> 'The capital of France is Paris.' finish_reason=stop. End-to-end generation confirmed.

(4) RANGE-RATIO VALIDATION (c=1): --random-range-ratio 1.0 yields FIXED 40k input on this SGLang v0.5.17 (verified: num_prompts=2 -> #Input tokens=80000 = exactly 40000 each; #Output tokens=3000 = 1500 each). So 1.0 is the correct/validated value for fixed 40k in / 1.5k out. Used 1.0 for the whole sweep. (SGLang semantics == range_ratio is the MIN fraction; 1.0 => [40000,40000] fixed. Prior vLLM run needed 0.0 -- DO NOT copy that value to SGLang.)

(5) DEVIATION (bench flag only, not server flag): DROPPED --flush-cache from the bench command and instead flush the prefix cache MANUALLY on the idle server before each level. REASON: bench_serving's post-warmup `flush_server_cache()` fires a single POST /flush_cache with NO retry; SGLang returns HTTP 400 whenever running/waiting reqs exist, and with our large 40k-in/1.5k-out WARMUP request still draining the flush deterministically 400s -> raise_for_status() aborts the entire run (reproduced twice at c=1). Manual pre-flush on the idle server achieves the identical goal (measured run starts with empty prefix cache, no cross-request prefix reuse). Sweep script (/opt/dlami/nvme/sweep_tp8.sh): for each C, POST /flush_cache retrying until 200 on idle server, settle 2s, then run bench WITHOUT --flush-cache, --output-file c${C}.jsonl, tee c${C}.log. NOTE FOR FEAT-003: the PD sweep will hit the SAME --flush-cache race -- reuse this manual-pre-flush pattern (against the router) instead of --flush-cache.

(6) SWEEP RESULT (fixed 40k in / 1.5k out, --random-range-ratio 1.0, backend sglang-oai on 127.0.0.1:30080). All 5 levels: completed == num_prompts, 0 FAILED. Artifacts in /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/: c{1,2,4,8,16}.jsonl + .log.
  c=1  (np8):  reqs 8/8  | TPOT med/p90/p99 = 1.20/1.37/1.43 ms | TTFT med/p90/p99 = 1711/3922/3946 ms | ITL med/p90/p99 = 1.19/1.42/2.36 ms | out tput 356.5 tok/s | total 9864 tok/s | accept len 5.74
  c=2  (np8):  reqs 8/8  | TPOT 2.36/3.01/4.05 | TTFT 1692/2022/2622 | ITL 1.29/1.55/2.60 | out 573.3 | total 15860 | accept 5.76
  c=4  (np12): reqs 12/12 | TPOT 5.38/8.72/11.33 | TTFT 2932/6918/8016 | ITL 1.44/1.73/17.35 | out 511.8 | total 14159 | accept 5.64
  c=8  (np24): reqs 24/24 | TPOT 7.17/10.51/15.72 | TTFT 3267/9074/11381 | ITL 1.67/2.02/66.02 | out 780.0 | total 21581 | accept 5.63
  c=16 (np48): reqs 48/48 | TPOT 15.02/24.54/37.13 | TTFT 4207/16741/23491 | ITL 1.96/2.93/507.52 | out 763.3 | total 21119 | accept 5.47

(7) DSPARK ACCEPT LENGTH: 5.47-5.76 across ALL levels -- far above 1.0, so DSpark spec-decode is strongly active and was NOT stripped (bundled draft arch DeepseekV4ForCausalLMDSpark accepting ~5-6 tokens/step). No investigation needed.

(8) END STATE: sglang-tp8 container LEFT RUNNING (Up ~28 min), /health=200, all 8 GPUs loaded, port 30080. Booking 5bd1f130 left running per boundaries (NO stop/terminate). TP8 bench artifacts preserved in /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ for the FEAT-004 comparison. Instance-side helper scripts written: /opt/dlami/nvme/{launch_tp8.sh,smoke_chat.sh,sweep_tp8.sh,collect.sh}.
